Show truthy and falsy values in Python.

Supplied answer
values = [0, 1, -1, "", "a", [], [0], {}, None, 0.0]
for v in values:
    print(repr(v), "->", bool(v))
# Falsy: 0, 0.0, "", [], (), {}, set(), None, False
# Everything else is truthy
Note: This is why if my_list: is the correct way to check for an empty list.
